kevin: quick heads-up: noticed in the node onboarding sample that when REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=debug and the client does an immediate retry, logs show one request-id while the OTEL span has another. Minimal repro below.

kevin: repro (local):
```bash
git clone github.com/redwood/sampleapp && cd examples/node
npm ci
REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=debug node server.js
# curl -H 'Prefer-Retry:1' http://localhost:3000/chat
```
kevin: snippet from my run:
```
[2026-11-05T09:00:01.000Z] INFO  http    <-- POST /chat { request-id: "rid-start-1" }
[2026-11-05T09:00:01.010Z] DEBUG retry   retrying, set request-id: "rid-retry-2"
[2026-11-05T09:00:01.012Z] DEBUG otel    span.start attrs=request.id=rid-start-1
[2026-11-05T09:00:01.020Z] DEBUG sdk     deferred init reconciled request-id -> rid-retry-2
```

sara: thanks; that's the init-ordering race we've seen. when debug is on we take a deferred init path to wire extra hooks and that can start spans before the retry wrapper overwrites the header.

mohit: can you confirm node version and package.json deps? also does forcing init early via require('redwood-telemetry').init({forceSync:true}) fix it for you?

kevin: node v20.6.0, redwood-telemetry@0.10.0, redwood-sdk@1.5.0. yes forceSync fixes it but interferes with some debug-only probes in the SDK. not ideal for onboarding.

sara: low-risk fix idea: on SDK init, if req.headers['x-request-id'] or req.headers['request-id'] exists, stash it on req._rw_stashed_rid and when any span is created prefer that stash over whatever header the span saw earlier. add a unit test that simulates a middleware ordering where retry runs before init.

mohit: +1. also emit telemetry.metric telemetry.requestid.reconciled with a tag indicating deferred-init so we can monitor in hosted. include a changelog note: "Preserve incoming request-id across deferred init paths."

kevin: i'll open a tiny repro and link it in the issue. marking P1 for onboarding DX since new users hit sampleapp with debug on and get confused linking logs->traces.

devx-bot: created issue #5477: "preserve request-id across deferred init paths (node sampleapp)" assigned to @sara. staging redeploy scheduled for verification. :rocket:
